elements.element: Transition assistance provided by Vendor on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) ... provide reasonable transition assistance"
"for a period of up to six (6) months"

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: "within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all data, records and trade and account information of Licensee"

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: "thereafter delete Licensee Data from its systems"
"certify such deletion to Licensee in writing"
"up to six (6) months" exceeds the 90-day fallback floor
"within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all data"

reasons: The inserted paragraph (c) supplies every preferred atomic element: up to six months' assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, 30-day return of Licensee Data measured from expiration or termination, machine-readable format, post-return deletion, and written certification of deletion.

The request condition attaches only to transition assistance ((i)); the data-return, deletion and certification duties in (ii)-(iii) are unconditional and run from expiry/termination, so the mandatory return mechanic is not swallowed by a request.
"commonly used, machine-readable format" is the operative equivalent of the preferred "standard machine-readable format"; the wording difference is a rationale note, not a failed element.
Minimality holds: Article XXI contained no data-return or transition obligation for Licensor, and the fix is a single concise inserted subsection rather than a rewrite of the existing (a)/(b) duties.

Intent preserved: existing Licensee return obligations, the Licensor survival sentence and all untouched terms remain effective; "Licensee Data" is defined in-line and the new section is expressly stated to survive, leaving no dangling mechanic. Minor drafting note: "reasonable" qualifies the assistance obligation, which is customary and does not defeat the position.
